name: @porchlight/inference
description: Porchlight engine inference tiering — the v0.3 local↔paid routing table (PORCH-133): tiered event-description inference (tier 0 local facts always-on, tier 1 local Ollama gated by entity FSM transitions, tier 2 paid OpenAI-compatible off by default until explicitly opted in), ordered escalation across tiers, and descriptions stored with the event they describe.
author: Brian Noah
